principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Typography with Industrial Ruggedness
Content is King: Data and Coverage maps are the heroes
Contrast: High contrast Navy vs White vs Safety Orange

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, stats. MUST be uppercase for top-level headings.

visual_enhancers.gradients: None. Use solid blocks of color.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark sections if possible.

layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. p-8 to p-16 for sections.

buttons.style: Sharp edges or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). Uppercase text. Bold.

cards.style: Flat, white background, 1px border (slate-200). No massive shadows. Technical look.

inputs.style: Square edges, bg-slate-50, border-slate-300 focus:border-slate-900 focus:ring-0

hero.treatment: Overlay with slate-900 at 60% opacity for text readability.

home.key_content: Fleet: 10 Own + 50 Associate Trucks. Routes: Ghaziabad, Agra, Nagpur, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai.

services.layout: Grid of detailed cards with icons.

routes.visualization: Use a stylized map component or SVG showing the North-South corridor (Ghaziabad to Chennai).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Swiss Industrial' look: High contrast, bold typography, structured grids.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings to give a 'Transport/Signage' feel.
Do not use generic blue gradients. Stick to Solid Navy (#0f172a) and Safety Orange (#f97316).
Ensure the 'Service Routes' page visually represents the corridor (Ghaziabad -> Chennai).
The footer must look like a legal document/manifest: dense, organized, containing GSTIN and legal info.
Use the provided image URLs. Do not use placeholders.
For the map, if you cannot build a complex interactive one, build a beautiful static SVG representation of the India route.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
